text: Egypt is bigger than France and Germany put together.
But look at it from space, at night.
Almost everyone lives on this one thin line.
About ninety-five percent of Egyptians live along the Nile.
sub: About 95% of Egyptians live along the Nile.

text: More than a hundred million people, on roughly four percent of the land.

text: The rest is the Sahara. In most of the country, it almost never rains.
So every field, every town, every city depends on one river.
Here, the whole green strip is only about eight kilometres wide.

text: Then the river fans out into the delta, where roughly half of all Egyptians live.
And Cairo sits right where the valley opens.
One river. A hundred million people.
